tools.name: ConnectPortal
tools.description: [L1][Portal][SESSION] Explicit connection by optional exact project filename stem. Uses running-process metadata before Attach, refuses multiple matching instances, reserves the chosen TIA instance against other same-user MCP processes, and captures PID/start time/full project path. Prefer ConnectProject for exact identity from ListPortalProcessProjects. Without a name, exactly one existing process is required; with none running a new instance starts.
